findings.summary: normalizeParams decoded each RFC 2231 continuation independently, so a later ISO-8859-1 octet lost the first segment charset and a UTF-8 character split across segments became replacement characters.
findings.fix: Reassemble continuation octets in numeric order and decode the complete value once using the charset declared on the first encoded segment. Unencoded pieces stay literal.
